mapper.select: SELECT a.user_id FROM data_source_authorization a LEFT JOIN user_multi_source_data d ON d.user_id = a.user_id AND d.source_type = a.source_type WHERE a.source_type = #{sourceType} AND a.auth_status = 'AUTHORIZED' AND (d.fetched_at IS NULL OR d.fetched_at < #{threshold}) ORDER BY (d.fetched_at IS NOT NULL), d.fetched_at LIMIT #{limit}
